title: Endpoint Initializer: Prose & Sketch Notes
body:
Purpose
---
This is a working doc for the initial endpoint creation flow that leans heavy on developer-first prose and short sketch annotations. Goal: reduce time-to-first-endpoint for new users while making model/version pinning explicit and low-friction for power users. This is intentionally conversational — notes, microcopy variants, and quick acceptance criteria to feed the grooming backlog.

User personas and success signals
- ML Platform Engineer (alice): needs predictable pinning and rollout controls; success = endpoint created, version pinned, smoke test pass in <10 minutes.
- Product Engineer (bob): wants a sane default with minimal decisions; success = usable endpoint with example curl + SDK snippet.
- Data Privacy Officer (carol): needs clear note about data routing and KMS; success = explicit VPC/KMS toggle present in flow.

Key constraints & principles
- Keep first-pass flow to 3 primary decisions: model, pin policy, route name/credentials.
- Expose advanced controls behind an "Advanced" accordion.
- Default: pick latest verified model for the chosen family; require explicit confirmation when pinning to an older version.

Wireframe frames (sketch-level prose)
Frame 1 — Starter card (choose model family)
  * Headline: "Start from a model"
  * Subhead: "Pick a model family to create an endpoint with recommended defaults."
  * Primary CTA: "Choose and continue" (opens model picker)
  * Microcopy variants below selector:
    - Option A: "Recommended: v2.1 — balanced latency and quality"
    - Option B: "Use latest verified (recommended)"
  * Tiny help link: "How are models verified?" -> modal with perf/cost bullets
Frame 2 — Model picker + quick compare
  * Left: list of model cards with badges (verified, quantized, cost tier)
  * Right: quick diff panel when selecting a model: latency (p50), cost/token, seq limit.
  * Copy candidate for cost badge: "~$0.0009/token (typical)" — allow rounding.
  * Tooltip language for verification: "Redwood-verified: smoke-tested on production workloads for correctness regressions and latency SLOs."
Frame 3 — Pinning decision (explicit)
  * Header: "Pin a model version?"
  * Two column options:
    - Radio 1: "Pin to a specific version (recommended for stable apps)" -> opens version dropdown and rollout toggle
    - Radio 2: "Use latest compatible version (auto-updates)" -> short warning: "Auto updates may change outputs; use for experimentation."
  * Microcopy drafts for warning:
    - "Auto updates may change output for subtle prompt differences. Pin when you need deterministic behavior."
    - "Pinned versions block automatic model changes; you can roll forward via the Rollouts page."
  * Accessibility note: ensure radio group has aria-describedby for the warning text.
Frame 4 — Route & creds
  * Fields: route name (slug), visibility (public/private), example SDK snippet auto-filled
  * Microcopy for route name placeholder: "e.g., chat-reply-v1"
  * Credential info line: "Create credentials now or reuse an existing key" (primary CTA: "Create key")
  * Copy variants for SDK snippet heading: "Try it locally" / "Example request"
Frame 5 — Advanced (collapsed by default)
  * Controls: batching policy, KV caching toggle, region selector, KMS key selector, network mode (VPC/Internet)
  * Microcopy for batching: "Adaptive batching recommended for throughput-sensitive apps. Learn more"
  * Tip: show estimated cost delta when enabling CPU fallback or different quantization presets.

Error states & edge copy
  * If pinned version is deprecated: "Selected version no longer receives performance updates. Continue?" (buttons: "Choose different version" / "Proceed and pin")
  * Capacity fallback message: "This endpoint will fallback to a lower-capacity model when Dedicated capacity is unavailable. Configure fallback in Routes settings."
  * Validation: route name uniqueness check should show inline error: "Name already in use in your org."

Acceptance criteria (for grooming)
- [ ] Starter flow creates an endpoint with default model and returns endpoint_id + SDK curl snippet
- [ ] Pin toggle saves pinning policy and visible on endpoint detail page
- [ ] Advanced controls collapsed by default and persist if opened
- [ ] Warning messaging appears when choosing auto-update for production orgs (org-level setting check)

Backlog items (Grooming notes)
- TASK-UI: Add model card badge taxonomy (verified, quantized, cost-tier).
- TASK-DEV: Endpoint API should accept pin_policy: {type: pinned|floating, version_id: optional}. (link to ENG-1234)
- TASK-UX: A/B test microcopy for "Use latest compatible version" warning (metric: rollback rate).
- TASK-SPEC: Define rollout semantics when rolling forward pinned endpoints (canary vs instant).

Open questions
- Should "pin by default" be org-level or per-project? (Tentative: org-level opt-in for stricter shops.)
- For the SDK snippet, do we include streaming example in the initial flow? (Prefer not — show toggle after creation.)

Notes to implementation team
- Model picker API must return a `recommended_reason` string for the selected default to display in the card.
- Include telemetry events: endpoint_create.started, endpoint_create.model_selected, endpoint_create.pinned (boolean).

Microcopy bank (short candidates)
- Primary CTA: "Create endpoint" / "Create and test" / "Create endpoint (recommended)"
- Pin question: "Do you want outputs to stay stable over time?"
- Tooltip: "Verified by Redwood — passed perf & regressions tests"
- Toast on success: "Endpoint created — test it with the snippet below."

Next steps for next sprint
- Finalize copy choices and run quick hallway usability with 3 engineers (5-10m flow)
- Wireframe hi-fi for dev console team with annotated accessibility labels
- Add small backend spike for pin_policy shape and migration notes

Quick sketch links (working)
- low-fi PNG sketches: /drive/sketches/endpoint-init-001.png (placeholder)
- preferred: embed after hi-fi passes

Misc (notes to self)
- Keep microcopy short in the main flow; provide inline "why" links for curious users.
- Avoid using "stable" without defining it (use pinned + version id).
- Reuse existing badge designs from model catalog to reduce dev overhead.

---
